visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young female toddler with pigtails wearing a sage green outfit carries a light blue plastic basket towards a wooden shelving unit filled with toy produce. (2) The toddler stands in front of the toy fruit section, reaching for a green plastic lime; she carefully picks it up and examines it against the bright indoor lighting. (3) She places the green fruit into her basket, which she holds with her left hand while using her right hand to navigate the shelves. (4) The scene cuts to her picking up a large red bell pepper toy from a lower wooden bin and dropping it into the basket with a quick motion. (5) She reaches for a toy broccoli head, holding it up to her face as if inspecting it while a pink pouch hangs from her waist. (6) The toddler identifies and picks up a toy mango, placing it into the blue basket alongside the other collected items. (7) She is now sitting on the carpeted floor next to her basket, holding a large toy strawberry and bringing it close to her mouth as if to take a bite. (8) She reaches for large pink dragon fruit toys, stacking them into her already crowded basket. (9) A final pink screen appears with a cartoon character illustration and text in the center.

(2) A sharp 'thud' sound as a plastic fruit hits the basket, followed by a female adult voice saying '橘子' with a rising, encouraging pitch. (3) Another plastic impact sound; the adult voice says '甜椒' in a warm, melodic tone. (4) The toddler says '這個!' with high enthusiasm, immediately followed by the adult identifying '青花菜'.
